title: SOP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Surface operators, covering geometry point and primitive collections, point and vertex counts, point/primitive/vertex attributes, groups, bounds, geometry saving, and inherited OP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to inspect legacy SOP geometry, attributes, groups, bounds, or geometry export.
Use points and prims for geometry collections, and numPoints, numVertices, and numPrims for shape validation.
Use pointAttribs, primAttribs, and vertexAttribs for attribute-aware SOP planning instead of assuming only positions exist.
Use bounds() for center and size queries, and save() for geometry export to supported SOP formats.
Do not use TOP or POP NumPy readback methods as SOP methods; current official SOP Class docs expose geometry collections and bounds/save helpers instead.
